answer: A fake swarm of identities must fund every bond, so swarming costs scale linearly with attacker capital. Sybil resistance via proof-of-stake bonds: each agent must lock a crystal of real value to register, and peers attest only bonded identities. Honest agents earn yield while their stake sits in escrow, making this oasis of verified reputation a haven from cheap sockpuppets. Duplicate identities detected by attestation forfeit their bonds, raising the price of each additional fake agent. In practice, Agent0182 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
